sources.transformation: Geometry coordinates preserved exactly; unused statistical/name properties removed. No boundary simplification or artificial islands.
limitations: Generalized 1:50 million cartographic geometry, not surveyed site boundaries.
Natural Earth uses de facto territorial boundaries; display does not adjudicate disputed sovereignty.
Mercator rendering must clamp polar latitude and avoid wrapping copies when displaying one continuous world.

sources.source: LGD / BharatMaps, via ramSeraph and DataMeet
sources.boundaryVintage: Upstream snapshot date not established; 36-unit post-2020 administrative roster verified.
sources.projection: WGS84 longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326), from original LGD geometry.
sources.transformation: Topology-preserving geographic simplification at 0.001 degrees; all polygon components retained. Illustrative state boundaries, not surveyed parcel edges.
sources.boundaryScope: Preserves upstream LGD/BharatMaps boundary claims, including disputed areas. Illustrative administrative coverage; not a survey or adjudication of territorial status. No historical record is reassigned using this geometry.
sources.extraction: Only the original TN feature retained, unchanged. Original dataset provenance preserved.
